adj. 足够的，很多的
adv. 足够","audio":"plenty.mp3"},{"word":"plus","pronun":"[plʌs]","translation":"prep. 加，加上
n. 正号，加号；好处；附加额
adj. 正的；附加的","audio":"plus.mp3"},{"word":"pocket","pronun":"[ˈpɑːkɪt]","translation":"n. 口袋；钱；容器

vi. 形成袋或囊","audio":"pocket.mp3"},{"word":"poet","pronun":"[ˈpoʊət]","translation":"n. 诗人","audio":"poet.mp3"},{"word":"point","pronun":"[pɔɪnt]","translation":"n. 要点；得分；标点；[机] 尖端
